title: Afar
prompt: Title slide with the Afar logo. Tagline: 'Plan the trip by talking to it'. Subline: 'Search flights, hotels and cars, with an AI that listens.'

title: Travel planning is still a pile of tabs
prompt: The problem: comparing flights, hotels and cars means many tabs, filters and repeated searches, and nothing helps you decide.

title: Meet Afar
prompt: One app that covers flights, hotels and cars and keeps your trips and saved deals together. Show the tab structure: Home, Saved, Trips, Profile, in a phone mockup.

title: Search that stays out of your way
prompt: The search flow: pick airports, dates and passengers, then see results and a flight detail page. Deals and destinations on Home.

title: Talk to your trip
prompt: The voice AI trip assistant. The user speaks and it answers in real time over a live call, using Stream Video and Gemini Realtime. Each user gets a personal call room.

title: Speaks your language
prompt: Native-language support: the user picks a language and the app and the assistant follow it.

title: Yours, and only yours
prompt: Accounts with Clerk (email plus one-time code). Saved deals and trips are kept per account, and a different account on the same device never sees them.

title: Built to be trusted
prompt: Architecture: Expo/React Native client; secrets and paid calls stay server-side in API routes after verifying the Clerk session; a separate Python agent service runs the AI.

title: Built feature by feature
prompt: Roadmap. Ships today: sample-data search for flights/hotels/cars, voice assistant, accounts. Next: live flight/hotel/car data, bookings, price alerts.

title: Let's take Afar further
prompt: Closing call to action with the logo, a one-line recap, and a contact/next-step placeholder.
